When redesign helps

Your website may still be online, but it should also feel credible, load quickly and make the next step obvious.

A redesign is useful when the brand has changed, mobile pages are difficult to use, content no longer reflects the business, enquiries are weak or the current site is hard to update. We audit what is worth keeping and rebuild the parts holding the experience back.

Our redesign process

Improve what matters without losing what already works.

Every stage is reviewed before development and launch.

Website audit

We review the current pages, mobile experience, content, speed, search setup and enquiry journey.

Strategy and wireframes

We decide what to keep, remove or restructure, then plan the priority pages and conversion paths.

Visual redesign and build

We create the new direction and develop responsive, accessible pages using efficient assets and clear interactions.

SEO migration and launch

We check URLs, redirects, metadata, analytics, forms, sitemap and key devices before the redesigned site goes live.

Website redesign questions

Protect visibility while improving the experience.

We confirm the migration plan before changing live URLs or content.

Will redesigning my website affect SEO?

A careful redesign protects important URLs and content, adds redirects where URLs change, and checks metadata, internal links, canonical URLs, structured data and the sitemap before launch.

Can you redesign my website without changing the domain?

Yes. Your existing domain can remain in place while the website design, page structure, content and technology are improved.

Can you improve only selected pages?

Yes. We can focus on high-value pages such as the homepage, service pages, landing pages and contact journey, or redesign the complete website.
